name: transcendent-third-classes
author: BlaXun
description: Renewal's thirteen third classes in pre-renewal, as the step after the classes you know. A transcendent class at base level 99 and job level 70 advances to its third class: it keeps every skill it has, its job level starts again at 1 and runs to 70, and its base level runs to 175. Guillotine Cross, Shadow Chaser, Arch Bishop, Rune Knight (with a Dragon Breeder), Royal Guard, Warlock (with a Spellbook Seller), Sura, Ranger, Minstrel and Wanderer, Genetic, Mechanic (with a Madogear from Einbroch) and Sorcerer (with elemental spirits). Every class has its own gear, dropped by monsters, the shops its skills need, measured damage and skill descriptions. Needs level175-core; the expanded advancements are the expanded-classes mod.
